name: Wetzlar (Germany)
description: Red field with narrow black stripes along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the city arms of Wetzlar (a black imperial eagle on yellow).
history: The arms were approved by the Hessian Minister of the Interior on 1 June 1965; the flag is described as a broad red middle stripe between narrow black side stripes with the arms.

features.role: Wetzlar arms — black eagle on yellow
